media:group.media:title: Full Grow Bag Garden Tour | May 31 Tour Zone 7b | Container Gardening
media:group.media:description:
This is the end of May full grow bag garden tour. There has been so much growth since the last garden tour and I am really loving the way my garden is shaping up. entry.title: Expanding the Growing Season for English Peas | Beating the Heat | Container Gardening

media:group.media:title: Expanding the Growing Season for English Peas | Beating the Heat | Container Gardening
media:group.media:description:
In the Piedmont Region of NC, hardiness zone 7b, we have an extremely short period of Spring weather and it quickly gets too hot for growing spring crops. Growing English peas have been a bit of a struggle until this year. I discuss our attempt this year to extend our growing season.

entry.title: Tying up Tomatoes and Transplanting Corn | May 2021 | Grow Bag Garden

media:group.media:title: Tying up Tomatoes and Transplanting Corn | May 2021 | Grow Bag Garden
media:group.media:description:
Our tomato plants are getting bigger and we needed to get them started on a trellis of some sort. So we are tying up tomatoes using t posts and the Florida weave for our grow bag garden. While our corn is not being grown in grow bags, but in a raised section behind it, our corn came up but there are areas that are sparse and others that came up thick so we decided to try transplanting corn with plants that we are thinning out.
